mentions.name: Digital life simplification
mentions.description: This project simplifies the author's digital and home life: most online accounts and subscriptions cancelled, all VPSes removed, phone apps stripped down to core ones, charging standardized on USB-C with two chargers and C-to-C cables, and the smart home downgraded to physical light toggles and a dumb wall panel for heat and AC.
mentions.source_excerpt: Simplification of my digital self. Removed most of my online accounts. Removed all my VPS's. Removed most apps from my phone except core ones. Cancelled a lot of online subscriptions.

evidence.value: Simplification of my digital self. Removed most of my online accounts. Removed all my VPS's. Removed most apps from my phone except core ones. Cancelled a lot of online subscriptions.
